purpose: This table provides cleaned airport reference data sourced from OurAirports via Airbyte, giving downstream geospatial and airport-lookup analytics a typed, deduplicated base of airport identity, location, and code attributes.
usage: Consumers should join on airport_id as the primary key, be prepared to handle nulls in elevation_ft, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, and keywords, and use has_scheduled_service as a boolean filter for commercial-service airports.
limitations: Cleanup could not resolve the high sparsity of local_code (63.66% null) and home_link (74.90% null), which remain nullable rather than imputed; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied; airbyte metadata columns were dropped entirely and are unavailable downstream.
